title: Playbook Skeleton (hosts, become, tasks, optional handler)
description: A clean starting point for any new playbook: a play against a chosen host pattern, privilege escalation, and one example task -- plus, optionally, an example notify/handler pair. Start every new playbook from this instead of a blank file. Ansible's own --check flag is the built-in dry-run, so nothing extra is needed here for that.

variables.name: PLAYBOOK_PURPOSE
variables.prompt: One-line description of what this playbook does (used as the play name)
variables.default: Describe what this playbook does here.

toggles.name: INCLUDE_HANDLER_EXAMPLE
toggles.prompt: Include an example task that notifies a handler
